description: Definitive evaluation contract specifying matching semantics, accounting rules, and adjudication logic.

semantics.file_matching: Normalized lowercase, forward-slash, without leading slashes. Exact match against claim permitted_files required.
semantics.symbol_matching: Normalized bare symbol name comparison. Qualified paths stripped to function/method identifier. If claim permitted_symbols is empty, file match suffices.
semantics.span_tolerance: Integer line tolerance of +/- 5 lines around claim permitted_spans. If permitted_spans is empty or finding has no start_line, symbol match is required.
semantics.one_to_one_matching: Strict 1-to-1 matching. At most 1 emitted finding can match a given ground-truth claim. Matched claims are consumed.
semantics.duplicate_fp_accounting: Any subsequent finding matching an already-consumed claim is accounted as duplicate_fp and penalized as an empirical FP.
semantics.unmatched_prediction_accounting: Any emitted finding on an ISSUE case that matches no ground-truth claim is penalized as an empirical FP.
semantics.unmatched_claim_accounting: Any ground-truth claim not matched by any emitted finding is penalized as an empirical FN.
semantics.clean_case_specificity: CLEAN cases must emit zero findings within evaluation scope. Emitting any finding is penalized as clean_case_fp.
semantics.structural_fact_exemption: STRUCTURAL_FACT findings (e.g. CONTRACT_*, IMPACT_*) are not counted as false alarms on CLEAN security/bug cases unless specifically scoped.
semantics.unknown_case_handling: UNKNOWN cases must emit zero positive defect findings. Emitting positive findings is penalized as incorrect_confident_positive (FP). Zero emissions scored as no_positive_publication.
semantics.reference_validity: Findings referencing non-existent files or out-of-bounds line numbers are flagged as invalid_reference and penalized as FP.
semantics.unsupported_claims: Findings violating forbidden_structural_facts or missing required_structural_facts are flagged as unsupported_claim and penalized as FP.
